Download the insights of the project that owns a live deployment. The /live/export/insights API accepts requests in the following format:

ExportLiveInsightsRequest Model - Request to download the insights of the live deployments of a project.
deployId string
required
example: L-6e9d8a78f5af89d401f630585be90e43
Id of a live deployment. The response contains the insights of all the deployments of its project.
Example 
{
  "deployId": "L-6e9d8a78f5af89d401f630585be90e43"
}
